curated.title: U.S. Post Office and Custom House, El Paso (Texas): third floor plan with court room, 1/8 in = 1 ft, 1888
curated.why: A federal post office and courthouse floor from the Supervising Architect's office at about 110 px/m: poché walls, cursive room names with sizes in feet and a 1/8-inch scale note, in place of the 18 px/m Bundesgericht print.

attribution.author: Office of the Supervising Architect, U.S. Treasury Department (Will A. Freret; NARA, Record Group 121)

scale.method: unknown: proposed by the pipeline (scale note 1/8 in = 1 ft and room sizes in feet and inches such as 30'-6" x 48'-6"; Commons original 6848 px wide)
